You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies a very small temporal system over a single variable s. The predicate F(var) holds when its argument is an integer in the range 0..9 and is even, and the specification requires that initially s = 0 and that every step satisfies the boxed subscript formula [][F(s')]_s. There is no explicit next-state action definition beyond the use of F applied to the primed state value, no fault model, and no proofs; the file mainly illustrates a temporal specification using a state predicate over a primed argument inside a stuttering-step box.
